## Bewertung

- Objective winners: `v2, v4-io`.
- Recommendation depends on objective; do not collapse the decision into one scalar without choosing priorities.
- Score v2 currently matches the balanced/tail ranking, but v4-io remains interesting for median/vertical behavior.
- Next calibration should explicitly choose whether p95/RMS or median/vertical performance is more important.
